name: Spines
description: Spines protrude from your body and can deal damage in melee or at very short ranges. Spines are hollow and hold a neural toxin that deals additional Toxic damage and can Slow or Immobilize your enemies. The toxin is cumulative, and multiple hits will affect a target more strongly. Very few foes have resistance to Spine poison. Like all scrapper powers, all Spine attacks can sometimes land a critical hit for double damage.

powers.name: Barb Swipe
powers.description:
Shred your opponent with a quick swipe from your Spines. Barb Swipe deals Light Lethal damage.

Spine poison deals additional Toxic damage and Slows affected foes. The more the poison stacks, the stonger it becomes.

powers.name: Lunge
powers.description:
You can lunge forward, stabbing and poisoning a foe with the large Spine on your arm. Lunge deals moderate damage.

Spine poison deals additional Toxic damage and Slows affected foes. The more the poison stacks, the stonger it becomes.

powers.name: Spine Burst
powers.description:
You can fling dozens of Spines in all directions. These Spines only travel a short distance, but they can deal moderate damage and poison any target close to you.

Spine poison deals additional Toxic damage and Slows affected foes. The more the poison stacks, the stonger it becomes.

Notes: Thanks to gauntlet, this power can hit up to 6 targets above its cap at 1/3rd effectiveness.

powers.name: Taunt
powers.description: Taunts a foe, and some nearby foes, to attack you. Useful for pulling villains off an ally who find themselves in over their head. Taunted foes tend to ignore other Heroes and focus on you for quite a while, so use this power cautiously. A To Hit check is required to Taunt enemy players, but is not needed against critter targets.

powers.name: Ripper
powers.description:
You can unleash a spectacular slashing maneuver that attacks all villains in a wide arc in front of you. Ripper deals massive damage and poisons multiple targets. It can even knock foes down.

Ripper will also cause much more toxic damage based on the amount of poison coursing through your opponent. You will gain a highlight ring when attacking a target with maximum poison.

Spine poison deals additional Toxic damage and Slows affected foes. The more the poison stacks, the stonger it becomes. Ripper inflicts poison at twice the rate of other powers.

Notes: Thanks to gauntlet, this power can hit up to 5 targets above its cap at 1/3rd effectiveness.

powers.name: Build Up
powers.description: Greatly increases the amount of damage you deal for a few seconds, as well as slightly increasing your chance to hit.

powers.name: Impale
powers.description:
You can throw a single large Spine at a targeted foe. This Spine does moderate damage, and carries a large amount of Spine poison. A successful attack can completely Immobilize most foes, as well as reducing their regeneration. Impale can also bring down flying entities.

Spine poison deals additional Toxic damage and Slows affected foes. The more the poison stacks, the stonger it becomes. Impale inflicts poison at twice the rate of other powers.

powers.name: Quills
powers.description: While this power is active, you will constantly fire dozens of Spines in all directions. These Spines do minor damage, but can poison all foes in close range, slowing their movement and recharge.

powers.name: Throw Spines
powers.description:
You can throw dozens of Spines in a wide cone in front of you, impaling foes caught within the range. Spine throwing deals moderate damage, and poisons any targets it hits.

Spine poison deals additional Toxic damage and Slows affected foes. The more the poison stacks, the stonger it becomes.
